confidence_notes: Current city price guides and cost-of-living aggregators support the restaurant, coffee, and beer estimates, though prices vary between downtown and tourist areas. The cocktail estimate uses a local bar-price guide; wine has little direct city-specific evidence and is estimated at roughly three times the beer anchor. Accommodation is a broad July-season estimate with more uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on inland Hunan prices and Zhangjiajie's mountain-tourism demand: ordinary local prices are modest, with higher costs around the scenic-area villages. Accommodation reflects a broad seasonal model estimate.
